question: The annual growth rate of consumer confidence index from 2000 to 2008
query: SELECT AVG(average_consumer_confidence_index) AS avg_annual_growth_rate_of_consumer_confidence  FROM (     SELECT year(date) as year,             LAG(consumer_confidence_index) OVER (ORDER BY year(date)) - consumer_confidence_index / NULLIF(LAG(consumer_confidence_index) OVER (ORDER BY year(date)), 0) AS average_consumer_confidence_index     FROM finance_economics_dataset     WHERE date >= '2000-01-01' AND date < '2010-01-01' )  WHERE consumer_confidence_index IS NOT NULL;
